title: Independent water-heater model validation
equipment: Electric recirculating water heater, outlet-temperature sensor, heater power stage, and cold-flow load
physicalPurpose: Determine whether the frozen identified heater model predicts new command and load behavior before it supports tuning.
principalTechnique: Independent holdout validation, residual diagnosis, and explicit model restriction
objective: Use new data without refitting to accept the local command model, restrict its disturbance purpose, and retain uncertainty, residuals, range, and verdict.

simplifications: The frozen FOPDT candidate models only heater-command to temperature behavior at fixed flow.
The cold-flow event is intentionally absent from the candidate model.
Deterministic data isolate model-purpose mismatch from measurement noise.
Other nonlinearities, changing efficiency, sensor dynamics, and faults are omitted.

baseline.limitation: Low error on the recording used to estimate parameters cannot establish prediction on unseen amplitude or disturbance data.

change.decision: Accept fixed-flow command response when its independent RMSE passes, but restrict load prediction when post-load residual bias fails.

disturbances: At 30 s, cold flow lowers the no-heat equilibrium by 1 degC

abortPredicates: PV, MV, prediction, residual, or timestamp is nonfinite
quality is bad or timing has a gap
PV exceeds 40 degC or MV leaves its limit
safety.restorationMode: Manual at 20 percent after the run, then 0 percent on safety abort
simulationOnlyRestrictions: A Simulation validation verdict cannot be presented as physical evidence.
The accepted purpose is fixed-flow heater-command response only; load prediction remains unqualified.

video.viewerOutcome: Validate a frozen model on genuinely new data and issue a useful restricted verdict when an unmodelled disturbance is exposed.
requiredVisibleEvidence: distinct estimation and validation run IDs

learning.context: The Lesson 16 FOPDT preview explains one estimation run but has not predicted a different amplitude or load event.
learning.reason: Only immutable data excluded from fitting can reveal generalization error and define the model's supported purpose and range.
theory: Estimation data determine parameters; validation data test a frozen model and must not be reused for refitting.
Residual is measured minus predicted PV; RMSE, bias, drift, oscillation, and introductory autocorrelation reveal different mismatch patterns.
Uncertainty intervals and prediction envelopes express finite evidence, while acceptance tolerances must be declared before seeing results.
A model may be accepted, restricted, or rejected; interpolation within tested conditions does not justify extrapolation to omitted disturbances or operating points.
learning.workedPrediction: The exact frozen model predicts 30.9993 degC for a new 20 to 25 percent step and about 30.639 degC at 6 s; an omitted -1 degC load later produces about -1 degC residual bias.
practicalPreparation: Verify different immutable run identity, frozen parameters, provenance, signals, units, quality, timing, limits, safe state, and predeclared tolerances.
Predict both the fixed-flow response and the sign and magnitude of residual after the omitted load before recording.
learning.baseline: Show the same-recording estimation fit and explain why its low residual is insufficient evidence.
learning.change: Write only P1.ExperimentEnabled; let the project own the 20-percent baseline, 25-percent step, and 20-percent restoration; then evaluate the frozen model unchanged across the separate cold-flow event.
learning.comparison: Compare estimation and validation errors, measured/predicted/envelope traces, fixed-flow residuals, and post-load bias without refitting.
learning.validation: Accept fixed-flow command response at RMSE at most 0.03 degC and restrict load prediction when residual bias magnitude is 0.9 to 1.1 degC.
learning.explanation: The smaller step confirms local command prediction; structured load residual proves the disturbance path is missing rather than random noise.
learning.transfer: Freeze, reserve, predict, measure, diagnose residuals, declare a purpose/range verdict, and carry that restriction into every later tuning or design action.
